job.goal: 30-second promo plus a short product walkthrough

scenes.brief: Opening brand card showing Stripe logo and tagline.
Dynamic aerial view of global payment flows illustrating Stripe's worldwide reach.
Clean hero image of code editor with Stripe API documentation on screen.
Navigate the Stripe Dashboard to create a payment link for a product.
Simple animated divider with the text 'Built for developers' and subtle motion.
Closing card with call‑to‑action: Start building with Stripe today.

voiceover.script: Stripe powers global commerce for businesses of all sizes. With a suite of APIs and tools, developers can accept payments, manage subscriptions, and move money worldwide—all from a single platform. Now, let's see how to create a payment link in the Stripe Dashboard: click Products, select Payment Links, create a new link, set your product name and price, then copy and share the link with customers. Start building with Stripe today.
